intro.text: A sport played on Scadrial that grew popular early in the third century PC.

description.text: Mayor Gave Entrone banned noseball in Bilming.
In Elendel, local leagues hand out flyers to recruit players.

items.text: Wayne put some of his money into a city-wide league in Elendel, with one team per octant and a stadium of its own. He asked his accountants to rename the sport and alter some of its rules.
